title: AngularLynx dev-server builder
description: Runs the rspeedy dev server, which Lynx Explorer and the web preview load the app from.

config.description: The rspeedy config file, relative to the project root. Defaults to lynx.config.ts (or .js, .mts, .mjs).

environment.description: Only build these rspeedy environments (e.g. lynx).
